rule: A1/A2: state as fact ONLY values with verified=true (or listed in verified_points); everything else must be framed as illustration / scenario / assumption in the Hebrew text.

data_status_legend.official: published decision/statistic; every value verified against the publisher
data_status_legend.official_approx: official series; only `verified_points` were checked - other anchors are interpolation inputs
data_status_legend.calibrated: model parameter chosen by the author; NOT data

boi_policy_rate.note: Path 2021-2026 via boi_rate_decisions (Trading Economics); 2025-11, 2026-01, 2026-07, 2026-09 decisions from BoI primary releases. Held 3.25% on 2026-10-21 (single secondary source).

unsold_new_dwellings.unit: dwellings, end of month (not seasonally adjusted)
unsold_new_dwellings.note: Sep-2026 SA value 86,666; 25.8 months of supply. CBS drops a unit 15 months after completion. Anchors before 2026 unverified.

residential_transactions.note: Verified: Apr-26 5,081; May-26 8,246; Aug-26 7,532. NOT verified: 2025 total 84,879, '20-year low' claim. Anchors before 2026 unverified.

dwelling_price_index.note: LEVELS UNVERIFIED (reconstruction). Verified y/y only: +0.5% Aug-Sep 2025; -2.0% Apr-May 2026; -1.8% Jul-Aug 2026.

legend.P: allowance for credit losses, same sectors

absorption_capacity_cdf.status: official points, spliced by the author

developer_credit_2025_bn_nis.note: Financial credit to residential construction projects, end-2024 -> end-2025 (primary text)

absorption_capacity_avg.note: Maximum fall in apartment sale prices without bank loss on the project, average. It is NOT a 58% drop in sales.

projects_construction_ahead_of_sales.unit: % of total exposure of the five groups

boi_macro_stress_test_2025.note: Full macro scenario with income and dynamic balance sheet; not our model

mizrahi_construction_split_2026q3.note: 7,613 vs nominal 18,293 NIS m; 32,470 of 54,876 NIS m = 59%

absorption_cdf_hapoalim_share.note: 52,634 of 99,962 NIS m; Hapoalim p. 61 note 4: completed value; Leumi p. 80 note c: inventory prices

unsold_2025_12_seasonally_adjusted.note: Fig 2 series is NOT seasonally adjusted (2025-12 anchor 86,090)

promo_share_long_delivery_new_deals.note: cited source predates/does not show the value; use promo_share_new_deals_2026_08

promo_share_new_deals_2026_08.unit: % of free-market developer sales, delivery >= 1 year, 5 monitored areas (Center, Tel Aviv, Hadera, Netanya, Beer Sheva)

dwelling_stock_total.note: CBS register includes estimates for several authorities that did not report

promo_share_free_market_5_areas.unit: % of free-market developer sales with delivery >= 1 year, in 5 monitored areas (Center, Tel Aviv, Hadera, Netanya, Beer Sheva)
promo_share_free_market_5_areas.note: Primary source. SUPERSEDES promo_share_new_deals_2026_08 = 33: the press page 15575 says 'about a third' only in its headline; body and MoF say 30%.

promo_share_of_new_sales.calibration_target: 20% May-2026 and 30% Aug-2026, free-market developer sales, delivery >= 1 year, 5 areas (mof_review_2026_08, p. 12)

simulation_outputs.status: calibrated - scenario results, never state as observed facts

status.Reported LTV: calibrated - typical first-lien LTV at origination (Israel: BOI reports ~50% of new mortgages above 60% LTV)
status.Effective LTV: calibrated - US: CLTV incl. piggy-back seconds; Spain: incl. consumer top-ups; Israel: model output = 75% regulatory LTV on NPV-discounted price (0.75/0.88)
status.Household debt / GDP: official - BIS credit to households (US Q4-2007 98.4%; Israel Dec-2025 42.5%); Spain 2007 approximate
status.Bank exposure to real estate: US/Spain: calibrated - stylised share of bank credit tied to real estate; Israel 2026: official - 39% of balance-sheet business credit to construction & real estate, 2025 (Bank of Israel, boi2026_recredit; supersedes ~40% in BOI FSR 2024H1)
